notes.title: DevBlog #5 Nearing Spooktober Preview
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]Sorry for the delay with the Devblog! Here are some screenshots we’ve finally updated the Rooms and the new Nests.[/p][p]There won’t be a patch this time since we first need to finish building all the loot rooms and then go through a round of bug fixing.

notes.title: DevBlog #4 Zombies vs Vampires Fest with Updated Demo
notes.content: [p]Demo Update and Art Changes[/p][p][b]## [0.2.0][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Hello everyone! With the Zombies vs Vampires Fest coming up on May 26, we've prepared a major update mostly to showcase the new art, along with some new features, changes, and bug fixes. There's still a lot of work to do, so you’ll notice some old art and missing features. We're working hard to get another update out soon, with even more content and areas in preparation for Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]You can now access all of this in the updated demo. I’d really appreciate your feedback on the art feel free to post your comments and I’ll be sure to check them out![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for the support. Since it's summer now here in Finland, I'm heading out to the sauna cheers to all of you![/p][p][/p][p][b]### Added[/b][/p][p]- Scaffolding has been added to buildings (this will be tweaked further)[/p][p]- Overgrowth now appears and can be cleared as you expand the station and reclaim areas[/p][p]- Russian language[/p][p][/p][p][b]### Changed[/b][/p][p]- Full Art rework 90% done[/p][p]- Zombies will now wake up if you disturb a nest[/p][p]- The Stalker shop has been removed until the next patch/area update[/p][p]- Civilians no longer have stamina[/p][p]- When stamina runs out, the main player can no longer run but can still walk[/p][p]- Minor sound adjustments (more rework planned for later)[/p][p]- Civilians will now move around while looting and building to make the world feel more alive[/p][p]- Game should run smoother on low end hardware[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]### Fixed[/b][/p][p]- If a barricade is destroyed, it can now be repaired after paying the fee[/p][p]- The boss should no longer get stuck on barricades[/p][p]- The barricade repair function now works correctly[/p]

notes.title: DevBlog #3 When is next update?
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone,[/b]
We've been hard at work replacing artwork, fixing bugs, improving performance, and adding new content.

I know many of you are wondering: When is the next update?

We’re excited to announce that we’ll be part of the Zombies vs. Vampires Fest, happening on May 26! This event will also mark the release of Version 2 of the game demo, along with an updated Steam page.

As for the new art—we're about 75% complete. If you happen to notice any old assets still in the game, don't worry—they're being replaced and will be updated in the new version.

So mark your calendars—I can't wait for you all to check out the updated demo.

notes.title: DevBlog #2 Future Plans
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone,[/b]

Happy New Year to you all! I hope this message finds you well.

I wanted to share some updates about the game’s development. We are currently hard at work on the next Game Update, and our goal is to release it as soon as possible. Right now, we’re estimating that it will be ready either in March or July, but I will keep you all updated as we make progress.

Once V2 is complete, the demo will also be updated. I highly encourage everyone to give it a try and share your feedback – your input is invaluable to us as we strive to make the game the best it can be.

In terms of art, I’m excited to announce that we’ve brought an artist on board! They are currently working on redoing all the artwork to improve its quality significantly. Here’s a preview:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44873059/fef9955441aece576a894f186469b75419756115.png[/img]

Thank you all for your support. We’re committed to delivering the game you’ve been waiting for, and we’ll continue to do our best to meet your expectations.

notes.title: DevBlog #1 Official Demo Steam Next Fest 2024
notes.content:
Official Demo + Major Game Rework
[b]## [0.1.0][/b]

[b]### Added[/b]
- New Mini Boss
- New Ranged Shop
- New Ranged Civ
- New Builder Shop
- New Builder Civ
- New Train Civ
- Now you can swap the Civilian you have selected to move forward (Press C)
- Loot rooms have now been added to the map
- Mutant nests will now spawn on the map, expand, and spawn mutants
- Added Vietnamese, Brazilian, and Swedish translations
- New sounds and random selection added to most objects and NPCs
- Rank system perk has been added, and the more kills, the higher the rank they can achieve
- Barbed Wire perk has been added, which will slow down mutants when close to barricades
- Damage boost building
- Health boost to barricade building
- Added tutorial videos (Can be disabled in settings or after the first game)

[b]### Changed[/b]
- Full UI rework
- Full game code rework to easily expand game mechanics
- Wave system has been reworked to allow the addition of special waves
- Fog will now only reach the stage where you built the barricade
- New Train model
- Barrels have now been added back to the map
- Lights added to the map to enhance the level's atmosphere
- Barricade models have been changed
- Attacks have been reworked for both Civs and Mutants

[b]### Fixed[/b]
- Openlevel will no longer crash the game
- FPS will no longer affect bullets or walking speed
